name: dither-image
title: Dither Image
description: Any image as a 4×4 Bayer dither in two theme colors, with a row drift on hover.

props.description: A div with role img. Extends div props. Size it with className.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Cross-origin images need CORS.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Dither cell in source pixels, 1 to 8.

props.name: drift
props.description: Hover drift in source pixels. 0 turns it off.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: CSS color or custom property for one tone.

props.name: paperColor
props.description: CSS color or custom property for the other tone.

accessibility: A role img element named by alt. The canvases are hidden from assistive tech.
The darker color always takes the shadows, so the image reads right in light and dark themes.

animation.timing: rAF while hovered, eases out on leave
